sentences.en: The United States has officially ended economic sanctions against Burma.
sentences.zh: 美国正式解除了对缅甸的经济制裁。

sentences.en: The US uses the UN to impose sanctions on Iran.
sentences.zh: 美国利用联合国对伊朗实施制裁。

sentences.en: The huge sanctions imposed are considered a financial nuclear war.
sentences.zh: 施加的巨大制裁被认为是金融核战。

senses.zh: 批准，认可；约束力；[常作pl.] 国际制裁
